name: Head Porter Mr Bowler

intro.text: Visitors to the college may not walk on the grass. I'm afraid that also applies to creatures. Shall we step outside?

win: Well. Carry on, Madam or Sir. I'll make a note of it in the Porter's book.
after: A head porter knows everything: whose bike is whose, who's staying where and who's been out after Great Tom. The Porter's Lodge is the best-informed place in any college and the only one that never sleeps.
